nextStoryContext: US-003 (Orchestrator exit tears down the session): pane 0 command in run.ts currently sends `claude --permission-mode bypassPermissions ...` via send-keys. US-003 needs to chain a `tmux kill-session -t <session>` after claude exits. The cleanest approach is to wrap the claude invocation in a bash one-liner: `claude ... ; tmux kill-session -t <session>`. The send-keys call in setupOrchestratorSession (run.ts) is the target. Unit test should assert the composed command contains the kill-session call.
